title: Verata's Gaze/Skill history
wikitext:
== [[Feedback:Game_updates/20260624|June 24, 2026]] ==
* Added functionality: Heals the claimed minion for {{gr|60|80}}.
* AI usage: 
** Increased priority of using this skill on 'masterless' minions. 
** Removed sacrifice function call since the skill does not sacrifice health. 
** Caster prioritizes the minion that has the highest health and skips minions that have low health (< 30%).
